### 1 — Scene
A meal of lasagna and mixed cooked vegetables, with a wrapped Magnum-style ice-cream bar and a glass of water. The wrapped item’s identity and size are less certain than the plated foods.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately **23 cm** diameter; area = 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ **415 cm²**.
- **Vegetable bowl:** approximately **20 cm** diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² ≈ **314 cm²**.
- The wrapped bar is estimated separately, without counting the loose wrapper as food.

### 3 — Items
Lasagna, including its visible cheese and tomato-based sauce; carrots; sweetcorn; broccoli; and the wrapped ice-cream bar. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible. Water contributes no energy.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Heights are average pile heights. Bulk density is the only volume-to-weight reduction used.

| Item | Vessel coverage / footprint | Height | Gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Lasagna | 40% of plate = 166 cm² | 2.0 cm | 332 ml | 0.95 | 315 g | 160 | 504 kcal |
| Carrots | 25% of bowl = 79 cm² | 1.5 cm | 118 ml | 0.60 | 71 g | 35 | 25 kcal |
| Sweetcorn | 17% of bowl = 53 cm² | 1.4 cm | 75 ml | 0.65 | 49 g | 96 | 47 kcal |
| Broccoli | 10% of bowl = 31 cm² | 2.0 cm | 63 ml | 0.55 | 35 g | 35 | 12 kcal |
| Chocolate-coated ice-cream bar, inferred from wrapper | Estimated food footprint 57 cm² | 2.0 cm | 114 ml | 0.70 | 80 g | 310 | 248 kcal |

**Coverage check:** approximately **40%** of the main plate and **52%** of the vegetable bowl are covered by food.

### 8 — Sanity check
The plated food totals approximately **470 g and 590 kcal**, plausible for the visible lasagna portion and vegetables. Including the estimated wrapped bar gives approximately **550 g and 840 kcal**. The bar is the least reliable estimate because its contents are concealed.
